lead.headline: Coinbase Aggressively Expands RWA and AI Integration
lead.tldr: Coinbase is pivoting toward a comprehensive financial super-app model by integrating tokenized equities and AI-driven advisory services.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Coinbase launching tokenized US stocks, backed 1:1, with holders able to receive dividends
top_signals.summary: Coinbase is launching tokenized US stocks that are backed 1:1 by the underlying assets. This initiative allows holders to receive dividends, positioning Coinbase against rivals like Robinhood and Kraken in the RWA space.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The entry of a major exchange into tokenized US stocks accelerates the migration of traditional equity liquidity onto the chain.

top_signals.title: Trump-backed World Liberty Financial nears OCC approval for federal trust charter: report
top_signals.summary: World Liberty Financial, a project backed by Donald Trump, is reportedly close to receiving a federal trust charter from the OCC. This approval would enable the entity to issue and redeem its USD1 stablecoin under a single federal regulator.
top_signals.why_it_matters: A federal trust charter for World Liberty Financial would create a high-profile precedent for stablecoin issuance under a single federal regulator.

top_signals.title: Coinbase unveils 'System Update' unlocking an AI advisor, global unified liquidity, options trading and more
top_signals.summary: Coinbase has announced a major 'System Update' introducing an AI-powered advisor and a unified liquidity pool for global trading. The update also expands the platform's offerings to include options trading and enhanced user experience features.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The 'System Update' signals a shift from simple brokerage to an AI-integrated wealth management platform, raising the bar for retail UX.

top_signals.title: State Street, Anchorage Back Fund for Stablecoin Reserves
top_signals.summary: State Street Investment Management has launched a new money market fund specifically designed for stablecoin issuers to manage their reserve assets. This move follows similar initiatives by other major financial institutions like JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley, signaling growing institutional adoption of stablecoin infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: State Street's dedicated reserve fund validates the transition of stablecoin backing from makeshift arrangements to institutional-grade money market funds.

top_signals.title: MANTRA to be acquired by Inveniam, backer that invested $20 million last year
top_signals.summary: MANTRA is being acquired by its previous backer, Inveniam, following a period of instability. The acquisition follows a major collapse of MANTRA's token value in 2025, leading to company restructuring and layoffs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The MANTRA acquisition serves as a cautionary tale regarding token volatility and the necessity of sustainable treasury management for RWA projects.

deals.summary: MANTRA is being acquired by its previous backer, Inveniam, following a period of instability. The acquisition follows a major collapse of MANTRA's token value in 2025, leading to company restructuring and layoffs.
Bitcoin miner IREN has expanded its operations into Europe by acquiring Spain's Nostrum Group. This move adds 490 MW of secured power to support the company's growing AI cloud business.

on_the_radar.title: BlackRock launches new Bitcoin ETF that generates income using a covered call strategy
on_the_radar.summary: BlackRock has launched a new Bitcoin ETF (BITA) that utilizes a covered call strategy to generate income. The fund holds Bitcoin and IBIT, selling call options on up to 35% of its holdings to provide yield for investors.

on_the_radar.title: Bipartisan senators push Treasury to uphold states' authorities under the GENIUS Act
on_the_radar.summary: A bipartisan group of U.S. senators is urging the Treasury Department to maintain the authority of individual states to regulate stablecoins. This effort is tied to the GENIUS Act and focuses on balancing federal and state oversight.

on_the_radar.title: Coinbase Adds ACATS Stock Transfers in Push Beyond Crypto
on_the_radar.summary: Coinbase has integrated ACATS stock transfers for its US users, allowing them to move traditional stock portfolios into the platform. This move is part of Coinbase's broader strategy to expand its brokerage offerings to include stocks, ETFs, and other trading products.

on_the_radar.title: Pump.fun activity craters 80% in three months, dragging Solana fees lower as traders rotate into perps
on_the_radar.summary: Pump.fun has experienced an 80% decline in activity over the last three months, contributing to a decrease in Solana network fees. This downturn is attributed to traders rotating their capital into perpetual contracts.

on_the_radar.title: Binance says it considers EU license compliant amid reports of potential rejection32m, Binance says it considers EU license compliant amid reports of potential rejectionWithout specifically calling out a report on Binance’s EU license, the crypto exchange warned that any rejection forcing it to delay activities in the region could “weaken liquidity” and present other potential risks.
on_the_radar.summary: Binance is defending its compliance status regarding EU licensing amid reports that it may face rejection. The exchange warned that a potential rejection could negatively impact liquidity and create operational risks within the region.

on_the_radar.title: Ripple Expands Africa Strategy With Flutterwave Investment
on_the_radar.summary: Ripple has invested in African fintech firm Flutterwave to enhance blockchain-powered remittances. Flutterwave will integrate RLUSD, Ripple Payments, and the XRP Ledger (XRPL) into its operations.

on_the_radar.title: SEC Chair Atkins defends CFTC's Selig despite questions over agency's ability to regulate prediction markets
on_the_radar.summary: SEC Chair Paul Atkins has expressed support for CFTC official Michael Selig regarding the regulation of prediction markets. This comes amid ongoing debates and questions concerning the CFTC's capacity to effectively oversee these specific derivatives markets.

linkedin_post:
The line between traditional finance and Web3 isn't just blurring—it's being erased by the platforms that control the gateway. 

Coinbase's latest moves to tokenize US stocks and integrate AI-powered advisory services signal a transition from a 'crypto exchange' to a global financial super-app. Simultaneously, the entry of State Street into stablecoin reserve management proves that the plumbing of the new financial system is being built by the old guard. 

While we see institutional adoption accelerating, the acquisition of MANTRA by Inveniam reminds us that token volatility remains a systemic risk for RWA projects that fail to manage their treasuries. The winners of this cycle won't just be those with the best tech, but those who can bridge the gap between institutional compliance and onchain efficiency.

Is the 'Super-App' model the inevitable endgame for centralized exchanges, or will decentralized alternatives find a way to disrupt this consolidation?

#RWA #Web3 #Fintech #InstitutionalAdoption
